materialGrid.summary: L99B: material 115 (Neck) returns a single value 1.0 for all 63 weapons and 328 ammo selections in both MP_Abbasid and MP_Badlands grids; abdomen material 25 (Spine) equals the limb value in all 328.

inference.fieldMeanings: The two floats are read as capsule length and radius, and the vec4 as a debug colour (Head red, Spine blue, Neck orange, limbs cyan/magenta). Basis: anatomical consistency (radius gives 44 cm torso, 22 cm thigh, 12 cm forearm; lengths track bone lengths). Field-name hashes are not reversible, so these are structure/value inferences.
inference.zoneMapping: Material 115 (Neck capsule) is the source of the site's chest multiplier 1.0; material 25 (Spine capsule) is the site's reduced stomach/abdomen zone.
inference.geometry: Capsules are placed on the bind pose along local +X. The offset frame is unresolved, so both local-axis and model-axis offsets were evaluated.

siteComparison.agreements: Head/torso boundary about 151-152 cm and torso/leg boundary about 78-82 cm match the site within a few cm.
differences: Centre line 108-136 cm (includes the site's default chest aim point, 121.98 cm): the site shows chest (1.0); source shows the Spine capsule (limb multiplier) under both offset conventions. Chest (115) appears from 140 cm (model-axis offsets) or 148 cm (local-axis offsets).
Head: source front area 739-775 cm2 vs site 539 cm2; top 185.5-187 cm vs 178 cm; half-width 14 cm vs about 11.5-12.5 cm.

Uniform disc of radius 10 cm at the chest aim point: site 100% chest (1.0); source 100% Spine/abdomen under both conventions. Radius 15 cm at the head aim point: site head 75.3%, miss 22.5%; source head 75-86%, chest (115) 14-20%, miss 0-5%.
Example: M433 at 0-21 m does 26.05 per chest hit (4 hits to kill) but 21.88 per abdomen/limb hit (0.84, 5 hits).
siteComparison.notComparable: Arms: the bind pose holds the arms out and down, not in the weapon-holding pose.

unresolved: Runtime use: whether native hit detection uses these capsules with front-most-surface selection, and any projectile collision radius (no named field found).
Offset frame (local vs model axes) and the in-game standing/aiming pose; only the bind pose is serialized in the skeleton.
Whether other soldier variants or modes use different collision (only Glacier_Soldier imports this asset in the decoder DB).
siteImpact: Candidate only; no site change. Replacing the artwork partitions with the source capsule projection would move the default chest-aim spray from chest (1.0) to abdomen (limb multiplier) and enlarge the head zone. Per the operator rule, a source-versus-game difference needs in-game evidence first. The site's chest multiplier 1 is now traced to material 115 (1.0 on all 328 selections).

captureProposal.test: Stationary standing helper in MP at 10 m (not the range dummy, whose collision asset and materials differ); M433 single ADS shots with damage numbers on, stepping up the centre line from belt to collarbone (about 100, 115, 125, 135, 145 cm). Record the loadout, target orientation, each shot's aim position (scope screenshot) and per-shot damage. Optional exploratory shots just above the helmet.
captureProposal.discriminates: Centre line: the site predicts 26 damage from about 107 cm up; source capsules (either offset convention, bind pose) predict about 22 damage up to 136 cm and 26 only from 140-148 cm. Above-helmet shots are exploratory only: the capsule top (185.5-187 cm) was compared with the site artwork, not located against the in-game helmet or animated skeleton, so no above-helmet headshot prediction is established.
captureProposal.measurability: Single shots with standing ADS spread; 4 vs 5 shots to kill and 26 vs 22 damage numbers are distinct at a glance; aim height is judged against the helper's belt, shoulders and collarbone in each scope screenshot.
captureProposal.dummyPilot: Not a validation target. The dummy's head capsule length (0.08 vs 0.06), chest material (637) and LeftArm material (115) differ from the soldier, and the range grid was not read, so a dummy result cannot directly validate soldier head size or torso multipliers.
